modalLead: Random theme in view mode now picks again when you switch dashboard pages — not only when jumping between bookmarks, config, inbox, and health. Help text and locales describe the broader trigger; an E2E test covers page-tab navigation.

items.text: Random theme rotates on dashboard page switches — with Random theme set to On view change, switching bookmark pages (tabs, 1–9, swipe, or hash) now picks a new theme from the pool, same as switching to config or inbox. Returning from another view still rotates once (not twice). Implemented via onDashboardPageChanged in dashboard-visual.js and _applyLoadedPageData in dashboard-data.js.

Help and locales mention page switches — Config → Help → Appearance, locale info strings, and MANUAL.md now say On view change includes dashboard page navigation. Config → Overview → Latest update and Advanced → What's new summarise this patch from the same what's-new data as the ★ modal.
